integrity: The primary source supplies quantifier elimination, the type metric, the one-type interval, continuum density for two-types, and the characterization of principal finite types. The retained theorem is proved by combining those ingredients with an exact radial-coordinate metric argument; a finite exact-arithmetic replay checks the underlying identities.
scientific_limitations: The cube theorem describes only the principal locus, not the full higher-arity type-space metric.
The statement is for types over the empty set and fixed positive radius.
The synthesis is short enough that an uncatalogued folklore occurrence remains possible.
title: Principal finite-type loci of richly branching R-trees are exact metric cubes
